ValidationRule.description: If Signature Verification Result is Refer to Service Center then Service Center Result must be Return to Signature Verifier.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(cc_Signature_Verifier_Result__c, "Refer to Service Center"),ISCHANGED(cc_Service_Centre_Result__c), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(cc_Service_Centre_Result__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Service_Centre_Result__c, "Return to Signature Verifier")), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Case Should be return to Signature Verifier as it was assigned by Signature Team.
